name: transcribe_refine
description: Clean a transcript: removes filler words (um, uh, ah, like, you know, etc.) and redacts PII (emails, phone numbers, SSNs, credit cards, account numbers). Timestamps are preserved. Pass optional custom rules for additional redactions.

name: transcribe_analyze
description: Store LLM-generated analysis of the transcript: topics discussed, sentiment, key entities (names, dates, amounts), meeting effectiveness, and follow-up items.

sentiment.description: Overall sentiment or per-speaker sentiment summary

key_entities.description: Names, dates, amounts, project names mentioned

follow_ups.description: Questions or items needing future discussion

name: transcribe_get_summary
description: READ-ONLY: Retrieve a previously stored summary. Only use AFTER transcribe_summarize has been called successfully. Do NOT use this to create or generate a summary.

name: transcribe_summarize
description: GENERATE and STORE a structured meeting summary from the transcript you have read. Pass the summary object with executive_summary, key_decisions, discussion_points, and action_items. This is the tool to call after reading the transcript — do NOT use transcribe_get_summary instead.

name: transcribe_label_speaker
description: Label an unknown speaker and save their voiceprint.

name: transcribe_prepare_delivery
description: Prepare deliverable package with transcript + summary.

name: transcribe_search_memory
description: Semantic search across past meeting transcripts and summaries using natural language. Returns matching meetings with relevance scores.

query.description: Natural language search query, e.g. 'budget discussion Q4'

name: transcribe_register_attendees
description: Register meeting attendees. Use when you know who attended a meeting but they weren't pre-registered. Source distinguishes 'new_job_form' (from upload) vs 'manual_labeling' (from speaker labeling).

name: transcribe_list_attendees
description: List all registered attendees across all meetings, newest first.

name: transcribe_search_attendees
description: Search registered attendees by name substring. Useful for checking whether a person is already in the registry before registering them.

name: transcribe_save_ephemeral
description: Save structured data to ephemeral memory: attendees, action items, contacts, budgets, decisions, or notes.

data.description: Data payload. For attendees: {names: [str], emails: [str], source, job_id}. For action_items: {job_id, items: [{description, assignee, deadline, priority}], meeting_title}. For contacts: {name, email, org, role, phone, meeting}. For budgets: {job_id, items: [{description, amount, currency, category}], meeting_title}. For decisions: {job_id, items: [{description, rationale, made_by}], meeting_title}. For notes: {job_id, topic, content}.

name: transcribe_query_ephemeral
description: Query ephemeral memory for attendees, action items, contacts, budgets, decisions, or notes. Optionally filter by keyword.

name: transcribe_save_context
description: Save full meeting context to both semantic and ephemeral memory at once. Call this after summarization to make the meeting searchable.

summary.description: Summary object with executive_summary, key_decisions, discussion_points

name: send_delivery_email
description: Send email with meeting summary and transcript via Gmail.

name: create_trello_action_items
description: Create Trello cards for action items.

name: save_to_drive
description: Save transcript and summary to Google Drive.

name: transcribe_upsert_job
description: Upsert a job record in the ephemeral jobs table. Accepts any subset of fields: token usage (totalPromptTokens, totalCompletionTokens, totalTokens, llmProvider, llmModel, inputCost, outputCost, totalCost), pipeline steps (pipelineSteps as JSON string), delivery results (deliveryAttempted, deliveryResults as JSON string), content metrics (transcriptSegmentCount, transcriptCharCount, summaryCharCount, hasAnalysis, analysisCharCount), and terminal state (result, errorMessage, completedAt). Safe to call multiple times — only provided fields are updated.

inputCost.description: Cost of input tokens in USD

outputCost.description: Cost of output tokens in USD

pipelineSteps.description: JSON array of per-step usage records

deliveryResults.description: JSON array of delivery tool results
